name: fet-platform
description: FET Revision & Exam Preparation Platform for South African Grade 10-12 learners

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
